title: Overcompensation and Overreaction Everywhere
coreMove: Recognize when spare capacity and rebound are adaptive reserves rather than waste.
sourcePressure: This chapter treats rebound, redundancy, and suppression backfire as cases where stress produces extra capacity or attention.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Assuming every overreaction is wise or every redundant layer is inefficiency.

sourceAnchors.name: redundancy
sourceAnchors.detail: source notes frame abundance and spare capacity as protection and adaptive capacity, not waste
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The spare part looks lazy until the day it becomes the reason the system learns instead of folds.

sourceAnchors.name: information suppression
sourceAnchors.detail: attempts to ban or suppress information can increase attention to it
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The ban can become the billboard when pressure turns curiosity into spread.
